[[A Ghostly Request]] }} Kill 5 groups of [[Corsair]] seamen in [[Lahtenda Bog]]. ==Quest information== === Requirements === {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = nightfall }} ===Objectives=== * Eliminate the [[corsair]]s camping out in [[Lahtenda Bog]]. 0..5 of 5 camps still remain. * See [[Guard Kovu]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 1500 [[Experience]] * 125 [[Gold]] * 15 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s * [[Battle Commendation]] ==Walkthrough== Head out into [[Lahtenda Bog]] and follow the green compass point to find the 5 corsair camps. There is a group of 6 level 15-17 Corsair Seamen at each camp. Expect pop-ups along the way. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Human]]s ([[Corsair]]s) *{{w}} 17 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (warrior)|Corsair Seaman]] *{{r}} 15 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (ranger)|Corsair Seaman]] *{{mo}} 15 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (monk)|Corsair Seaman]] *{{n}} 15 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (necromancer)|Corsair Seaman]] *{{p}} 16 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (paragon)|Corsair Seaman]] *{{d}} 15 (25) [[Corsair Seaman (dervish)|Corsair Seaman]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Guard Kovu :''"Now that we know where the corsairs are gathering, we have the perfect opportunity to catch them off guard and chase them out of Lahtenda Bog. I don't know who this '''Ironfist''' guy is, but we're not about to wait to find out. , take a moment to ready your party then head out and take out all the '''corsairs''' camping out in the swamp."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = The only corsairs leaving that swamp will be dead ones. | decline = Swamp? I just had a pedicure. | ask = Head out to '''Lahtenda Bog''' and clear out those '''corsair camps'''. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== :'''Corsair Seaman:''' ''"How long do we have to wait here for Ironfist? This swamp gives me the creeps."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Guard Kovu :''"Hope those corsairs didn't give you too much trouble. As individual crews, they aren't very threatening, but when they gather together into an armada they're dangerous. This Ironfist sounds like he could be a real problem. Keep your eyes peeled for any information you can gather. Sounds like we don't have much time."'' [[Category:Rewards Battle Commendation]] [[Category:Rewards Sunspear promotion points]]
